title: The audition with the Basie band
summary: He describes walking in scared, playing the blues, Basie's silence, and being told to work that night.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Well, Freddie, now let's just say then -- you auditioned. When did you audition? I mean how far had they gotten -- had they finished the Roseland then?
No, they were still there. They were still working down there.
Yeah.
I came -- I was still at the Black Cat.
Yeah.
And, I came over and did an audition one afternoon.
I'd like to hear about it. (laugh)
(laugh)
Who were the guys, first of all?
Huh?
Who were the guys? Who was in the band?
Let's see. When I came in I think there were -- I think they had a rehearsal that day or something.
Yeah.
And, the guys were all standing around, you know. And, I walked in and I was scared. (laugh)
(laugh)
You know, I waited -- you know, everybody just -- I was alone and nobody came up and said 'yeah', you know. I felt -- I really felt lonely, you know? (laugh)
(laugh)
Yeah. But, I was determined. I said 'no, no, somebody's going to hear me play'. (laugh)
(laugh)
So --
Basie came over?
Basie came over. He just got through talking to somebody, cause he wasn't there during that period, you know.
Yeah.

He was out somewhere, and then finally he came in. And, I think they started playing something -- I don't know what it was. I think it was the blues they started playing, and I just started playing with them. I think Walter Page came over. And, it wasn't a big thing. I didn't know whether I got the job or not, really. You know, it wasn't anything real big, and I just knew -- you know, it was so abrupt until -- I just knew I didn't get it, you know. I just said "Oh, well, okay", you know. (laugh)
Nobody said anything?

Nobody said anything. (laugh) As I can remember now. And, the next thing I remember -- I don't know whether anybody came over and told me that it was okay, or what -- but, I think Basie said it sounded good, you know. And, I think Herschel probably said something -- something like that, -- I don't know.
Yeah.
But, anyway -- that night I went to work, you know?
